sentence: This project studies how cannabis chemical levels relate to heart problems in people living with HIV.
This project uses Drosophila genetics to find genes that control cardiomyocyte polyploidization and may be linked to heart disease.
This project builds a computational tool that measures a protein on stained tumor slides, using multiplex immunofluorescence staining as a reference.
This project tries to find out whether experience-dependent changes in neuronal circuits increase the need for sleep, using a machine learning algorithm and a model.
This project tries to find out how a central regulator of inflammation promotes clonal hematopoiesis, a condition of aging with mutations in blood cells.
This project studies how cell types in the injured mammalian lung are generated, how they behave and which molecular pathways control alveolar repair.
This project tries to find out why breast cancer resists immunotherapy and whether another cancer drug can improve the response.
This project builds engineered immune cell therapies that eliminate senescence-associated tumor states by targeting a surface antigen.
This project covers research topics in human genetics, health, physiology and disease.
This project studies whether the stiffness of the tissue where cancer spreads changes how well immune cells kill cancer cells.
This project studies how a protein secreted by the microbiome makes pancreatic beta-cells multiply and secrete insulin.
This project helps design clinical trials, animal studies and translational research, using suitable statistical methods to address the hypotheses of study aims.
This project offers tissue imaging and analysis tools to study cells in the liver, pancreas and gastrointestinal tract.
This project builds a method that detects viral pathogens and reads their genomic sequence so diagnostic tests keep working as pathogens evolve.
This project makes airway and alveolar stem cells from human induced pluripotent stem cells and tests their safety for lung diseases.
This project studies how Zika virus passes from mother to fetal brain and how it is linked to microcephaly.
This project studies the genetics of animals in a breeding colony to preserve genetic variation and pick animals for infectious disease research.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools that process cardiac scans automatically to assess patients more accurately than visual analysis of images.
This project builds editing tools that add a chemical modification to human mRNAs at chosen sites, using a directed evolution platform.
